title: Building – Distance of Roof Soffits and the Exposing Building Face of a Detached Garage March 2012
description: A property owner built a detached garage whose roof soffit projected closer to the property line than the 0.45 m allowed. The as-built location also differed from the permit plans.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order; the panel pointed to a variance as an available route

outcome_summary: Directives were unchanged, but the deadline moved from 31 Jan 2012 to 30 June 2012, giving time to comply or seek a variance.
